headline: Computer C17693 used dozens of likely stolen passwords on 8 October to break into 210 machines across the network.
summary: On 8 October, computer C17693 tried to log in with 135 different accounts aimed at 311 machines, about nine times its normal activity. Most attempts failed, but 49 accounts got in and reached 210 machines. Every one of those 49 accounts normally signs in from a different computer, which strongly suggests their passwords were stolen. The activity ran from about 8:30 in the morning until after 11 at night, all over network logins.
